subject: Fieldstone: mutual success plan & procurement timeline
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Gomes <aisha.gomes@fieldstone.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fieldstone discovery recap & initial milestones

Hi Aisha — great conversation this morning. Quick recap and a proposed mutual success plan so we can align stakeholders and dates. Please confirm or flag changes.

Pain points you called out:
- Latency spikes on inference during peak catalog updates (up to 2.5s per token) impacting search relevance.
- High per-request cost from current supplier for embeddings and rerank at scale.
- Need for predictable throughput during holiday surge windows.

Goals (90-day):
1) Pilot (30–60 days) with Redwood Dedicated capacity for the search rerank path to validate stable p95 latency < 400ms and cost reduction target -30% per 1M tokens.
2) Define acceptance criteria and success metrics for the POC (see proposed criteria attached).
3) Procurement & security sign-off for production rollout by early Aug (your timeline).

Proposed Milestones (draft):
- Jul 20: Share MPA spreadsheet with milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria (ACTION: Redwood)
- Jul 24: Fieldstone engineering kickoff (90-min deep dive) (OWNER: Fieldstone eng lead)
- Jul 31: Run 2-week pilot with sample traffic; shared dashboards and cost/lantency breakdowns (OWNER: Redwood + Fieldstone)
- Aug 07: Procurement & legal review complete; pricing and SLA agreed (OWNER: Fieldstone procurement + Redwood sales)
- Aug 14: Go/no-go for production rollout

Open items for you to confirm:
- List of stakeholders to include in MPA (engineering, procurement, legal, analytics)
- Any hard blocks on residency/SOC2 requirements we should include now
- Preferred demo windows for the kickoff

Attachments: POC acceptance criteria (draft) — sending with a follow-up shortly.

Thanks again — I’ll drop the MPA workbook by EOD.

Best,
Markus Klein
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

Cc: Evan Locke <evan.locke@fieldstone.ai>, procurement@fieldstone.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fieldstone discovery recap & initial milestones

Thanks Markus — that captured everything from our side. A couple clarifications and our timeline commitments below.

Confirmed pain points & goals: agree with the three bullets and the 30–60 day pilot objective. Acceptance criteria we care most about: p95 latency, token-cost per query, and no regression on relevance (top-5 CTR).

Procurement/legal cadence:
- Legal review (T+7 business days) — expected complete by Jul 27
- Procurement sign-off target: Aug 8 (we need pricing + standard SOC2 + data residency notes to present to our buying committee)

Stakeholders (please include in the MPA):
- Aisha Gomes — VP Product (primary sponsor)
- Evan Locke — Head of Infrastructure (technical owner)
- Procurement team — procurement@fieldstone.ai (finance/contract owner)
- Maria Chen — Analytics (success criteria owner)

Please include the SOC 2 scope and whether we can get a scoped evidence packet for the pilot (we don’t need full attestations for pilot, but our procurement wants a clear roadmap).

I’ve attached our POC acceptance criteria doc with slightly more detail. Evan — I’ve looped you to confirm the kickoff date availability for next week.

Best,
Aisha
VP, Product | Fieldstone AI
Aisha.Gomes@fieldstone.ai

Aisha / Evan — attaching the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (spreadsheet) and a short SOC2 evidence summary for pilot scope. Key notes:

What's in the MPA (tab names):
- Milestones & dates (owner, acceptance criteria)
- Technical checklist (KV cache, batching, sample traffic settings)
- Observability & handoffs (dashboard links, SLOs)
- Commercial (pilot pricing, discount options, SLA exceptions)

Proposed kickoff windows: Jul 24 or Jul 26 (90-min deep dive). Tell us which works and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Short answers to your asks:
- SOC2: we can provide a scoped evidence packet (redacted logs, config history) for pilot. Full attestation available for production.
- Data residency: pilot can run in us-west region; production options include eu-west if needed (we can lock this in during procurement).

Subject: Re: Fieldstone MPA v1 + kickoff windows (pricing note)

Hi Aisha — quick note from me: thanks for the alignment. Two small additions before we lock dates:

1) Pricing flexibility: we can offer a time-limited pilot credit that effectively reduces unit cost for the pilot window (we typically apply this to prove ops characteristics). If the metrics hit the acceptance criteria we’ll roll the agreed pricing into a committed Dedicated capacity proposal.
2) SLA exception: for the pilot we can provide elevated telemetry and a 24/7 on-call window for Redwood engineers during the 2-week run. We’ll document that in the MPA.

If that sounds good I’d propose we tentatively book Jul 24 for the deep dive and set a legal/procurement checkpoint on Aug 7 so Fieldstone has internal materials ready for Aug 8 sign-off.

Thanks — Ben
